title: Orvan wheat: the sea loss is real, the substitutes are small

facts.subject: Orvan sea disruption
facts.statement: The corridor agreement ended on 10 September and the port strike began on 14 September.

source_ref.text_snippet: The corridor agreement ended on 10 September and the port strike began on 14 September.

facts.subject: sea routes value loss
facts.statement: On our numbers, the four main sea routes could lose half to three-fifths of their value in the fourth quarter.

source_ref.text_snippet: On our numbers, the four main sea routes could lose half to three-fifths of their value in the fourth quarter.

facts.subject: Vanir wheat sales
facts.statement: Vanir wheat sales to Tolan and Midgard may rise by between a seventh and a fifth in volume, again from a small base.

source_ref.text_snippet: Vanir wheat sales to Tolan and Midgard may rise by between a seventh and a fifth in volume, again from a small base.

facts.subject: sea index forecast
facts.statement: We expect the sea index to stay near 30 to 40 through December and to recover only slowly.

source_ref.text_snippet: We expect the sea index to stay near 30 to 40 through December and to recover only slowly.

validation_notes: Citation repaired: quote found in ¶9, not cited ¶8

flagged_facts.subject: Rail volume increase
flagged_facts.statement: Rail through Ravik may add about 54% in volume on a base of USD 25M a month.

source_ref.text_snippet: Rail through Ravik may add about 54% in volume on a base of USD 25M a month.

validation_notes: Verifier: statement only partially supported. Numeric value of 54% is stated but not explicitly confirmed as a fact in the paragraph.
